summary: The current backend branch includes truthful persisted realized/open/replay P&L fields and passes 81 focused tests locally. I am extending the workstream to harden the paper-only flatten flow and tests before consuming the API from the phone Site. No broker/live execution authority is involved.

active coordination currently reports zero collisions and no reservation for these exact paths
